title: TCS New York City Marathon — The Start
claims: The 2026 start timeline is: 8:00 a.m. men's professional wheelchair division, 8:02 a.m. women's professional wheelchair division, 8:22 a.m. handcycles and select athletes with disabilities, 8:35 a.m. professional women's open division and 9:05 a.m. professional men's open division.
Mass waves start at 9:10, 9:45, 10:20, 10:55 and 11:30 a.m. for waves 1 to 5.
Runners may move to a later wave or corral but may not move to an earlier or faster wave or corral.
A runner's finish time is the net time from crossing the start line.
Only registered entrants and guides are allowed in Fort Wadsworth and the start area; race numbers must be visible and bag colours indicate the start village.
There are more than 1,600 toilets in the start villages and corrals.
Runner amenities in the start villages include Gatorade Endurance Formula, Dunkin' coffee, tea, hot cocoa and bagels while supplies last.
Extra layers are advised, and discarded clothing can be placed in labelled donation bins.
Dedicated lactation spaces are available in the start village, and personal breast pumps are transported from start to finish lactation tents.
ASL interpreters are present in the AWD tent and general start village from 5:00 a.m. to 11:30 a.m.
A dedicated sensory space offers a low-stimulation environment before the race.
The NYRR Pace Team has an average 96% success rate of hitting target finish times and leads groups from 6:40 to 14:18 per mile, between 2:55 and 6:15 finishes.
